items.title: Hinton Milt — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: One day Chuck Stewart said to me

ctx.x: Yes. He used to kid because I‟ve been lucky enough to get pictures that he couldn‟t get because I‟m already in the studio and they didn‟t let a photographer in while we were recording because of the ticking of the camera. I‟m in there already with my camera. Every time the conductor takes a break to explain something I got a picture. One day Chuck Stewart said to me, “That‟s all right one of these days I‟m going to get a good bass” [laughter].

But in listening to the things that you say about people, you know, Kid Oray and all those guys, there was something still that… Red Allen for instance. I mean I hear… Louis Armstrong to me was one of the greatest jazz artists ever but Louis didn‟t do it all. I mean Red Allen, Freddy Kephard…
